description: This file defines a custom CMake function 'CreateLink' to create symbolic links during the configuration phase. It parses arguments for link and target paths, creates necessary directories, and then creates the symlink using appropriate commands depending on the CMake version.

methods.name: CreateLink
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link from TARGET to LINK as specified by the provided arguments. It checks the CMake version to decide which command to use for creating the symlink and ensures the directory for the link exists.
